description: This Java abstract class serves as a base model for auditable entities, providing created and updated timestamp fields with annotations for JPA persistence and auditing support.

classes.name: AuditModel
classes.description: An abstract superclass providing auditing features for entity classes, including timestamp fields for creation and last modification.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the entity.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the entity.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the last modified timestamp of the entity.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last modified timestamp of the entity.
